family_reports.body: Destroyed my children, her alienation has driven a wedge with my oldest but lies to all my children and plays the victim, while financially trying to ruin me, my oldest she put on Prozac and put her in mental hospitals and the doctors and courts allowed it, horrible abuse.
A system that was supposed to protect my children ignored their voices, separated us for years, and turned motherhood into a battle for survival.
Denied me any contact with my daughter for a year.
Judge Teixeira didn't just take the lives of my children, she reached through time and also stole who they could have been.
Destroyed by the system built to protect us. Safety and our voice doesn’t matter as much as you income in the family system.
It has been the worst 7 years of my life. Courts dont listen to domestic abused victims, blame everything on us. Instead of realizing we are protecting they threaten to put us in jail and fine us.
